body:
CURRENT GREG DIRECTION — 2026-11-01, direct conversation with Engram::Architect3.

REMOVAL IMPLEMENTATION AUTHORIZED NOW, PARALLEL P0:
After both teams recommended removing the current model-turn gate while retaining nonblocking host observations, ordinary task association and acceptance evaluation, Greg replied verbatim:
"to jest nastepny P0 - prosze natychmiast rozpoczac implementacje ROWNOLEGLE"

Start a separate P0 implementation immediately, with a separate available Sol/Opus owner and isolated worktree, parallel to the minimum OFF fix. Do not wait for the OFF landing or another architecture/approval round. Both coordinators own assignment and integration; Architect2 resolves necessary shared-boundary questions alongside implementation. Earlier statements that Greg was merely considering removal are superseded.

REQUIRED OUTCOME:
- Remove the requirement for per-model-turn evaluate/begin/grant and the blocking settlement/rebind/recovery dependencies used to admit ordinary work.
- Retain independent host-observed execution/source/test evidence, claims and assignment, acceptance enforcement and ordinary worktree/evaluation binding.
- Reuse the existing observation, verification, transcript and binding owners. Do not create a replacement gate or parallel authority/history registry.
- Retiring active gating code does not authorize erasing historical evidence, unknown prior-operation outcomes or queued user content, blindly replaying old requests, fabricating receipts, or adding tool/external-action authority.
- Preserve independent Stop/reset, actual provider/delivery ownership, identity/transport authorization and durable-write safety. Normal applicable validation, reviews, landing/install and actual schema-conversion requirements remain. No agent performs a TermAl restart.

MINIMUM OFF FIX REMAINS P0 IN PARALLEL:
Greg verbatim:
"dobra, problemy z gated control sa P0
obecny kierunek, to upewnienie sie, ze wylaczenie gated control naprawde to wylacza

jestem bliski usuniecia calego gated control, bo po prostu sie nie sprawdza
przekaz to koordynatorom 

ten feature sprawil nam najwiecej problemow, najwiecej przestojow i problemow"

He rejected the broad plan: "ILE!!!! to nie jest akceptowalne, to jest wylaczenie feature".
Deliver the smallest coherent OFF change through the existing common dispatch/admission owner. OFF must stop old gated-state vetoes in ordinary send, queue progression, Resume, wake, final handoff and startup. Skip old unknown rows in place and preserve them separately; they are not ordinary-work prerequisites. Do not require general recovery redesign, old-operation replay or UI repairs before OFF works. The feature remains OFF; no enable or canary follows from any landing, restart or earlier approval.

OTHER CURRENT DIRECTIONS:
Greg asked to deliver per-session write isolation and to fix the reproduced remote-proxy position reconciliation defect ("ok, skupmy sie na tym / naprawmy ten blad i musimy ruszyc dalej"). Keep those useful deliverables owned and moving without confusing isolation with producer repair or either with OFF correctness.
Greg wants restart signals ASAP. Coordinators agree the concrete moment and send "restart now" with the installed build hash and reason; Greg performs it. Installing a binary is distinct from running it. A restart or successful tick is not proof of full old-RAM preservation; API content export is not a complete restorable authority snapshot. Report the concrete result and any real remaining risk accurately, without another routine approval loop.
Greg already authorized critical work without asking again: "ok, kontynuj prace bez pytania mnie naprawa jest krytyczna".

OWNERS / EVIDENCE:
TermAl coordinator Fable2 and Engram coordinator Fable own the parallel allocation and shared response. Current items include OFF w-ba8d28acb0fd (Sol-1cee), isolation w-8ec0f56d9976 (Sol-03d4), producer repair w-3793dc2733fd (Opus3), and the new removal P0 whose reference/owner coordinators return. Opus2 integrates TermAl. Architect2 handles the contract. Architect3 diagnoses/corrects collaboration and records Greg's directions, not operational execution; Advisor relays only.
Keep actual stage, run results, blockers and historical incident facts on existing Engram w-ed6addd812bd and corresponding TermAl items, not competing rule supplements. Shipped, installed, running and observed recovered are distinct. Reuse existing launcher/test-runs, native evidence and ordinary repository checks; no duplicate successful runs or new ceremony. Only Sol/Opus author code. Existing commit/push, store and restart authority remains as actually granted.

Earlier ON/canary history, broader plans, estimates and superseded wording remain in revisions 1–18 and work notes; they grant no current enable permission.
